name: Namazu Trader
description: When this creature enters, you lose 1 life and create a Treasure token. Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, surveil 2.
assumptions: Treated the unflagged treasure node as exactly one Treasure token, by analogy with other unflagged single-token nodes.
Rendered the gate between the optional sacrifice and surveil as "If you do" — the schema fixes that surveil is gated on the sac happening, not the exact phrasing.
Ordered ETB-then-attack ability matching flow.roots order.
notes: Exact match on mana cost, type line, P/T, and full rules text (both abilities, including the optional sac / surveil 2 conditional) against real oracle text. This is the schema's own original worked example (SCHEMA.md §6) — a clean match here confirms the node/flow rewrite preserved fidelity through the whole redesign, not just that the schema handles simple cards.
